domains.title: Scope, authorization, mode, and source freshness

checks.title: Authorization basis and investigator role captured
Case or incident reference captured
Investigation mode declared with limitations
Observation window and timezone defined
Primary sources and advisory versions verified

domains.title: Evidence inventory, hashes, custody, duplicates, and gaps

checks.title: Every in-scope file has a manifest status
Original SHA-256 captured independently
Chain-of-custody fields are available
Exact duplicates identified without confidence inflation
Unreadable, excluded, oversized, and unsupported evidence recorded

domains.title: Device identity, platform, version, HA, clock, uptime, and reload

checks.title: Hostname or case-scoped pseudonym resolved
Chassis/serial references correlated across artifacts
Platform family and model inferred or declared
Application, package, host, and firmware versions inventoried
HA role, peer, clock/NTP, uptime, and reload reason assessed

domains.title: Users, privilege, SSH keys, AAA, dormant accounts, and MFA

checks.title: Local users, privilege, and credential types reviewed
AAA authentication/authorization/accounting method order reviewed
TACACS/RADIUS/ISE server identities and health correlated
SSH keys, dormant accounts, fallback, and break-glass use reviewed
MFA challenge and VPN accounting evidence correlated

domains.title: Management services, exposure, ACLs, and access history

checks.title: SSH, Telnet, HTTP(S), ASDM, API, NETCONF, RESTCONF, and SNMP inventoried
VTY/management ACLs, source interfaces, and OOB restrictions reviewed
Internet and untrusted-network exposure assessed
Successful/failed access and source infrastructure reviewed
Legacy services and Smart Install exposure assessed

domains.title: Configuration baselines, risky deltas, EEM, archive, logging, and NTP

checks.title: Running, startup, committed, checkpoint, and known-good baselines compared
EEM/kron/scheduler triggers and full action bodies reviewed
Archive destination, protocol, schedule, and retention reviewed
Logging destinations, severity, facility, timestamps, and sequence settings reviewed
NTP sources, clock changes, and timestamp integrity reviewed

domains.title: Sessions, processes, sockets, listeners, CPU, memory, and containers

checks.title: Current users, VTY, VPN, and management sessions reviewed
Processes, services, and high-port listeners reviewed
CPU, memory, heaps, watchdog, and health anomalies reviewed
GuestShell, bash, app-hosting, and container state reviewed
Visible and potentially hidden packet-capture state assessed

domains.title: Filesystem artifacts, scripts, packages, crash data, and support bundles

checks.title: Flash, bootflash, disk0, harddisk, crashinfo, and cache inventoried
Unexpected scripts, archives, plugins, web assets, and binaries reviewed
Crashinfo, cores, tracebacks, and reload artifacts reviewed
Packages, SMUs, hotfixes, install history, and signatures reviewed
Support-bundle snapshot time and completeness assessed

domains.title: Image, package, boot, ROMMON, GRUB, FXOS, Secure Boot, and Trust Anchor

checks.title: Offline image/package hashes compared with authoritative source
Boot variables, image selection, and fallback images reviewed
ROMMON/GRUB versions, regions, and persistence evidence reviewed
FXOS/host layer separated from ASA/FTD application layer
Secure Boot, Trust Anchor, authenticity, and console evidence reviewed

domains.title: ARP/MAC, routing protocols, loopbacks, ACL/NAT, tunnels, and control plane

checks.title: ARP/MAC and routing-neighbor state reviewed
BGP peers, route policy, prefix lists, and default advertisement reviewed
Loopbacks and their use as routing/tunnel/management sources reviewed
ACL, NAT, object, and policy changes reviewed
GRE, IPsec, SD-WAN, MPLS/LDP, and other tunnels reviewed

domains.title: VPN, WebVPN, certificates, trustpoints, PKI, IKE, and IPsec

checks.title: Remote-access and site-to-site sessions correlated with AAA
SSL VPN, WebVPN, and IKEv2 client-services exposure reviewed
Tunnel groups, group policies, crypto maps, and profiles reviewed
Trustpoints, certificates, serials, issuers, and validity reviewed
Private-key and certificate exposure/rotation scope assessed

domains.title: Packet capture, SPAN/ERSPAN, NetFlow/IPFIX, PCAP/NDR, DNS, proxy, and firewall

checks.title: WAN, LAN-inside, management, OOB, and upstream sensor vantage recorded
NetFlow/IPFIX source/destination, volume, flags, and export trust reviewed
PCAP/PCAPNG metadata, capture point, and encryption limits reviewed
SPAN/ERSPAN source scope and destinations reviewed
TFTP, FTP, SCP, high-port SSH, GRE, proxy, DNS, and management egress reviewed

domains.title: Cisco malware and threat-specific artifact branches

checks.title: LINE DANCER, LINE RUNNER, RayInitiator, LINE VIPER, and FIRESTARTER branches assessed
BadCandy account-only, implant, variant, and reboot behavior assessed
SYNful Knock, Jaguar Tooth, BlackTech, and historical IOS tradecraft assessed
JumbledPath, Velvet Ant, tpacap, EPC, and Linux-layer artifacts assessed
ZuoRAT, KV/JDY Botnet, and Cisco RV reinfection risk assessed

domains.title: Persistence, staged relaunch, credential access, and reinfection

checks.title: Image, bootkit, ROMMON, GRUB, and FXOS persistence assessed
Users, keys, AAA fallback, EEM/kron, boot, and archive persistence assessed
Client bundles, web assets, service files, and container persistence assessed
Controller templates, service packages, tokens, and credential vault persistence assessed
EOL, exposure, credential, and external reinfection paths assessed

domains.title: Logging loss, deceptive output, hidden captures, time changes, and forced reload

checks.title: Selective/total syslog loss and collector failure differentiated
Missing AAA/command accounting and local fallback differentiated
Deceptive verify/copy/show/EEM output paths assessed
NTP changes, timestamp rollback, cleared histories, and sequence gaps reviewed
Immediate/delayed reload, no-dump events, and failover context reviewed

domains.title: Controller, orchestrator, automation, and fleet blast radius

checks.title: Controller/orchestrator trust established before remediation
Admin/API token, command runner, deployment, and audit history reviewed
Templates, services, policies, objects, and device pushes correlated
SWIM/image/package/hotfix provenance reviewed
Per-device provenance and fleet-wide pattern separated

domains.title: Crown jewels, reachability, credential exposure, and business impact

checks.title: AD, RADIUS, TACACS, ISE, PKI, PAM, and MFA exposure assessed
Internet gateways, VPN, SD-WAN, cloud on-ramps, and egress exposure assessed
Sensitive, regulated, classified, and customer network reachability assessed
OT/ICS, safety, building, camera, and plant adjacency assessed
Core routing, route reflectors, policy chokepoints, and business impact assessed

domains.title: Hypotheses, benign alternatives, confidence ceiling, response readiness, and next evidence

checks.title: Ranked compromise and benign hypotheses recorded
Supporting, contradicting, and missing evidence linked
Evidence confidence ceiling and untested layers stated
Immediate, 24-hour, recovery, and hardening actions assigned
SOC, network, TAC/CISA/NCSC, executive, and fleet handoffs prepared
